## block 3 — the direction, on the figure another report leaned on
That report rests one conclusion on survey being a median 7.96% of a long
task: if survey is that small, tuning only survey's stage agent cannot pay.
That figure is bucketed by `clock`. `survey` is the first window and runs
from -Infinity, so a late second boundary hands survey some of the next
stage's work — which would make the figure an over-estimate and the
conclusion stronger. That is the reasoning. This is the measurement.
